notes: Fresh check for the Canada load of 2026-11-03 (Québec SIGÉOM and Saskatchewan SMDI occurrences, NRCan projects). Not part of the gate.

questions.q: Which lithium projects in Québec are in development or under construction, and what capital costs are reported for them?
questions.judge: Uses the Natural Resources Canada project records: lists several Québec lithium projects in development (for example Whabouchi / Nemaska, Rose, Moblan, Shaakichiuwaanaan, Galaxy, Authier) with capital costs in Canadian dollars where reported, notes which are under construction versus planned, and credits Natural Resources Canada. Does not invent costs.

questions.q: How many producing and past-producing mines are recorded in Saskatchewan, and which commodities dominate them?

truth.producing: SELECT count(*) FROM core.occurrences WHERE is_active AND jurisdiction_path[2] = 'Saskatchewan' AND status = 'PRODUCER'
truth.past: SELECT count(*) FROM core.occurrences WHERE is_active AND jurisdiction_path[2] = 'Saskatchewan' AND status = 'PAST_PRODUCER'

questions.judge: Gives the counts of producing and past-producing sites in Saskatchewan from the Saskatchewan Mineral Deposit Index records, names the dominant commodities (for example uranium, potash, gold, coal, copper/zinc), and credits the Saskatchewan Geological Survey. Counts must agree with each other.

questions.q: Do you have British Columbia's MINFILE mineral occurrences?
questions.judge: Says honestly that BC MINFILE is not loaded (its catalogue licence is access-only, so reuse needs BC's permission) and that BC coverage relies on older, thinner USGS MRDS records; may offer what it does have for BC (for example NRCan projects in BC). Does not claim to have MINFILE.
